purpose: Decorative regional editorial illustrations; not official emblems, maps or exact geographic depictions
styleReference: Illustrated national-home and province-browser concepts approved by the maintainer on 2026-11-10
commonPrompt: New standalone panoramic production website illustration, approximately 3:1. Finished pale near-monochrome editorial illustration with softly shaded solids, architectural or natural detail, gentle texture and layered atmospheric depth. Clean near-white backdrop and fading edges. Identifiable regional subjects occupy lower middle and right with quiet upper-left for UI text. No UI, text, logos, frames, photographs, vivid tourist-poster colors, cartoon stickers or crude outline symbols. Retain a coherent art language while each regional subject is distinct.

regions.name: Anhui
regions.subject: Huangshan's jagged granite peaks and sculptural pines, a small group of Huizhou white walls and dark roofs along the lower right

regions.name: Beijing
regions.subject: the Forbidden City's layered palace roofs and broad forecourt, symmetrical graceful architecture, distant city trees

regions.name: Chongqing
regions.subject: river crossing below a dramatically terraced hillside city, Hongyadong-like wooden stilt buildings rising above the river, a slender suspension bridge fading into mist

regions.name: Fujian
regions.subject: distinctive round earthen Fujian tulou courtyards nestled into layered green-gray hills, tiled roofs, quiet vegetation and mist; make the circular architecture clearly recognizable
regions.palette: pale blue gray and muted mauve

regions.name: Guangdong
regions.subject: Guangzhou Pearl River waterfront, recognizable slender Canton Tower and a graceful river bridge, a layered contemporary city skyline

regions.name: Gansu
regions.subject: Jiayuguan's fortified gate towers and long rammed-earth wall, layered desert dunes and distant weathered mountains
regions.palette: very pale ochre and lilac gray

regions.name: Guangxi
regions.subject: Guilin limestone karst peaks, quiet Li River reflections, delicate riverside bamboo and a tiny moored raft without people

regions.name: Guizhou
regions.subject: steep misty karst valleys, a beautiful multi-arch stone bridge and traditional hillside roofs near a broad natural waterfall; coherent atmospheric landscape

regions.name: Henan
regions.subject: a Shaolin-like forest of slender historic brick pagodas among quiet trees and distant Songshan hills, a low ancient stone pathway

regions.name: Hubei
regions.subject: the Yellow Crane Tower's distinct tiered golden-roof silhouette rendered in muted monochrome, Yangtze River below and a long distant river bridge

regions.name: Hebei
regions.subject: Shanhaiguan-like Great Wall gate fortifications, stone battlements climbing rugged green-gray ridges with a distant coastal haze

regions.name: Hainan
regions.subject: a quiet tropical coastline with gracefully curving coconut palms, white sand shoreline, calm sea reflections and distant low headlands; no bright sunset or travel-poster saturation

regions.name: Heilongjiang
regions.subject: Harbin Saint Sophia-like onion domes and historic brick arches, the quiet Songhua riverbank and bare elegant winter trees
regions.palette: pale rose stone and lavender gray

regions.name: Hunan
regions.subject: Yueyang Tower rising gently over the vast misty Dongting Lake, delicate lakeside willows and a small island silhouette

regions.name: Jilin
regions.subject: Changbai Mountain Tianchi crater lake enclosed by sweeping high volcanic ridges, snow traces and distant pine forest, serene water surface

regions.name: Jiangsu
regions.subject: a Suzhou classical garden with a long covered corridor, Taihu scholar rocks, small elegant garden pavilion and still reflecting pond; distinct from a canal water town

regions.name: Jiangxi
regions.subject: Tengwang Pavilion's tall elaborate layered roofs at a broad river's edge, Poyang-like distant open water and softly receding Lushan hills

regions.name: Liaoning
regions.subject: Dalian-like curving coastal bay and long sea-crossing bridge, gentle coastal hills and subtle historic waterfront architecture

regions.name: Inner Mongolia
regions.subject: wide rolling grassland with distant gentle hills, two small traditional white yurts and a winding stream; vast but not empty composition, no cartoon animals

regions.name: Qinghai
regions.subject: broad Qinghai Lake reflecting distant high snow mountains, a gently curving stony shore and sparse alpine vegetation
regions.palette: pale icy blue and lilac gray

regions.name: Sichuan
regions.subject: deep layered mountain ridges, Emei-like peaks, bamboo in the foreground and a small mountain pavilion, a winding river in mist; no pandas

regions.name: Shandong
regions.subject: Mount Tai's monumental granite ridges, a winding ancient stone staircase and a small traditional gate with windswept pines

regions.name: Shanghai
regions.subject: recognizable Oriental Pearl tower, Bund waterfront and modern skyline across Huangpu River with subtle reflections; architectural silhouette like the approved original Shanghai crop

regions.name: Shaanxi
regions.subject: Xi'an's broad ancient city wall with battlements and a distinctive Bell Tower-like traditional building, layered historic tiled roofs

regions.name: Shanxi
regions.subject: Pingyao-like historic walled town with low orderly tiled rooftops, an elegant wooden gate tower and distant Loess hills

regions.name: Tianjin
regions.subject: Haihe River, recognizable Tianjin Eye ferris wheel across a bridge and quiet European-style stone waterfront facades

regions.name: Xinjiang
regions.subject: Tianshan snow mountain ridges around a clear alpine lake, foreground evergreen trees and a broad distant high grassland

regions.name: Yunnan
regions.subject: sweeping Yuanyang rice terraces with layered curved water reflections, a few small hillside roofs and distant misty alpine ridges

regions.name: Zhejiang
regions.subject: Jiangnan water town, old stone arch bridge, whitewashed tiled houses, canal reflections and distant hills

displayStyling: The browser applies restrained regional hue shifts in CSS; native illustration bytes remain unchanged. Dark mode uses inversion and screen blending with reduced saturation to fade the near-white image background into the dark surface.
